target_models.reference: Moliner & Valimaki (2022) Historical Audio Restoration U-Net (de-click + hiss)

io_contract.output: restored PCM (n_samples, 2) + explicit residual = input - restored
restored PCM (n_samples, 2) + explicit residual = input - restored

colab_handoff_spec.local_post_colab_verification: Re-evaluate returned restored/residual WAVs locally via research.e6_declick_hiss.evaluate_e6_case on the exact same dev-e6-archival-v1 clean/attack/tail masks; never promote into Preserve.

evaluation_rules: Never compute paired reconstruction SDR/SI-SDR on unpaired real transfers.
Loudness-match identity vs DSP vs learned outputs within <= 0.2 LU after FLAC encode.
Audition both restored output and isolated residual (`removed = input - restored`) to verify zero musical attack/cymbal/vocal leakage in the removed signal.
Score blind A/B preference + artifact rubric (pumping, musical noise, dulled attacks, cut reverb tails) with randomized blind IDs.
